content:
**Alpha Thrashers** are creatures found in Appalachia.

| Image | Name | Appears |
| | Alpha Thrasher | *Fallout 76* |
| | Glowing Thrasher | *Fallout 76* |
| | Scorched Thrasher | *Fallout 76* |

- One around Naked Creek.
- Appears in the Random Encounter Turkey Tea.
- Can appear as enemy in waves during the quest Gathering Clouds.

Alpha Thrashers appear in *Fallout 76*.
